transports.https: documented, with an Authorization header carrying the auth token

bundle_semantics: the overview describes Send Bundle as suited for transaction order, atomicity and execution within the same block

parameters.name: maxBlockNumber
parameters.meaning: last block for which the bundle is valid; default is current block plus 100

parameters.name: minTimestamp
parameters.meaning: earliest unix time in seconds for which the bundle is valid

parameters.name: maxTimestamp
parameters.meaning: latest unix time in seconds for which the bundle is valid

parameters.name: revertingTxHashes
parameters.meaning: transactions that are allowed to revert

parameters.name: noMerge
parameters.meaning: default false, which allows the bundle to be merged with others

parameters.name: positionFirst
parameters.meaning: default false; when set, bundles are ordered strictly by priority fee; when unset, a late bundle may be appended at the block tail

response.success: result is the bundle hash as a string
response.failure: JSON-RPC error object with code and message; the documented example, code -38000, rejects a maxBlockNumber smaller than the current block number

max_block_number_boundary: the documented rejection is for a value smaller than the current block number; a value equal to it is not described as rejected

fee_floor_statements.statement: the gas price of transactions within the bundle must be at least the minimum required by BSC validators, currently 0.05 gwei
the average gas price of a bundle must not be below 0.05 gwei, computed over the transactions that do not come from the mempool, with a tip to the builder added to the numerator

fee_floor_conflict: the two statements describe different rules; neither is adopted as a formula
